description: Convert a raster image to SVG using potrace vectorization. Best for line art, diagrams, logos, and high-contrast images. The image must already exist in /tmp/churn-udbd3sfk/Pictures/pixel-surgeon (use save_image to import first).

filename.description: Filename of the source image in /tmp/churn-udbd3sfk/Pictures/pixel-surgeon

invert.description: Invert the image before tracing (useful for light-on-dark images)

threshold.description: Brightness threshold for black/white conversion (0-255). Lower = more black. -1 = auto-detect. Default: auto.

turdsize.description: Suppress speckles up to this size (in pixels). Default: 2.

name: trace_to_svg
